svg.aria-label: Boss fight: the $10K/month agency retainer throws hidden fees, a Monthly Report PDF, a Strategy Call and Scope Creep; claude-seo, claude-ads and claude-blog beat each one, and their open-source combo fells it for an MIT license
svg.title: Boss fight: the $10K/month agency retainer throws hidden fees, a Monthly Report PDF, a Strategy Call and Scope Creep; claude-seo, claude-ads and claude-blog beat each one, and their open-source combo fells it for an MIT license

g.text: A fog wall blocks the way...
claude-seo rolls out of the way.
The PDF had no real numbers.
That call could have been a post.
